clock_native.purpose: Same binary A/B old reset clock and bounded catchup clock; transport credits unchanged

probe_native.purpose: Delivery/Worker receipt/producer-clock instrumentation; no transport or playback behavior change

limitations: ABBA reset runs had CPU spikes (74.3% and 66.6%), whereas catchup runs were quiet; do not rank counts as an equal-load speedup.
A quiet reset probe run independently showed 2 flat-head intervals with a maximum consume gap of only 14.1 ms and 36.59 ms discarded source-clock time.
A deterministic test uses the actual PlaybackClock and reproduces freezes from repeated 15 ms source delays with reset scheduling, eliminated with catchup scheduling.
Pausing the indexer changed competing work; the source patch cannot guarantee smooth rendering during arbitrary OS/GPU starvation.
